next_lap_should: Stop trying to make one lap show a delta. The data to measure cost already exists in two places nobody has joined: the git history of state/claude-usage.json is a per-collection record of the weekly percentage, and state/laps.json records started_at/ended_at for every lap including the unusable ones. Total points consumed over an interval, divided by the number of laps recorded inside it, is an upper bound on cost per lap — an upper bound is exactly what a reserve needs, and anything under 0.5% immediately loosens the gate. That is route (a), and it needs no new collection.

archive_policy: A successor archives its predecessor at startup, and only when get_session reports SESSION_STATUS_IDLE. A session cannot archive itself: doing so stops it before its own final record is written. 'I spawned you' does not mean 'I have finished' — the predecessor may still be committing.
